entries.name: Koupon
entries.one_liner_zh: 把一件商品的几个优惠码先自动试、再人工读条款，标出能用、过期或能用但不值，最后到结账页再试一次。
entries.one_liner_en: Try each promo code automatically, read its terms like a person, stamp it works, expired or not worth it, then try it once more at checkout.

entries.name: Reco Social
entries.name_zh: Reco Social · 帖子里藏着什么
entries.one_liner_zh: 从一条帖子里找出顺口提到的店、片和物件，变成小卡片，挑几张放进自己的清单。
entries.one_liner_en: Find the places, films and things mentioned in passing in a post, turn them into small cards, and keep a few in your own list.

entries.name: Muse from Meta
entries.name_zh: Muse from Meta · 一件事交给它
entries.one_liner_zh: 交出一件小事，看它列出步骤，在要发信或付钱之前停下来等你点头，最后留下一行记录。
entries.one_liner_en: Hand over one small errand, watch it lay out the steps, and see it stop for your OK before anything is sent or spent.

entries.name: BigFuture School
entries.one_liner_zh: 打开一张折好的成绩条，看完两项虚构分数，再从三条方向里选一条放进笔记。
entries.one_liner_en: Open a folded score slip, read two invented section scores, then keep one of three directions in a short note.

entries.name: GoWish
entries.one_liner_zh: 一份可以加愿望、再标成预留或已收到的短清单。
entries.one_liner_en: A short list you can add to, then mark a line reserved or received.

entries.name: WorkBuddy
entries.one_liner_zh: 一张安静的书桌：今日的事情放在一边，把「帮我做这件事」一步一步走完。
entries.one_liner_en: A quiet desk: today’s tasks on one side, and a short “help me do this” you can step through.

entries.name: DramaWave
entries.one_liner_zh: 竖着读三则原创的微场景。点一下，或轻轻一滑，就到下一拍。
entries.one_liner_en: A vertical reader for three original micro-scenes. Tap or swipe to the next beat.
